```lean
intro v
obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := v
have h1 : p ≠ Ideal.ideal R := by contrapose! hp; exact Ideal.isPrincipal_iff_eq_ideal_one.mp (Ideal.isPrincipal_iff_eq_ideal_one.mpr hp)
have h2 : Ideal.absNorm p = Ideal.norm p := by rw [Ideal.absNorm_def, Ideal.norm_eq_abs]
have h3 : Ideal.norm p ≠ 0 := by rw [Ideal.norm_zero]; exact not_le_zero (Ideal.norm_nonneg _)
have h4 : Ideal.norm p = Ideal.radical (Ideal.pow (Ideal.ideal R) 1) := by rw [Ideal.norm_eq_radical]
have h5 : Ideal.radical (Ideal.pow (Ideal.ideal R) 1) = Ideal.ideal R := by rw [Ideal.radical_ideal_one]
have h6 : Ideal.norm p = Ideal.norm (Ideal.ideal R) := by rw [h4, h5]
have h7 : Ideal.norm (Ideal.ideal R) = 1 := by rw [Ideal.norm_one]
have h8 : Ideal.norm p = 1 := by rw [h6, h7]
contradiction
```
